description.value: Caffe Fantastico is a locally-owned, family-run coffee roastery operating multiple café locations in Victoria, BC, roasting a diverse menu of sustainably sourced coffees from value staples to boutique microlots. Beyond espresso drinks, the bar-deli offers deli items and charcuterie boxes available for pickup seven days a week. The business has a strong community focus, regularly hosting poetry slams, live music, and book launches at its venues.
